capabilities: arrange images side by side as image rows with adjustable width, order, alignment and gap
wrap text around an image on the left or right with adjustable width and side
edit rows and wraps by dragging image handles and hover bars in Live Preview
merge, split, center and reorder image rows via commands
apply the same layouts when exporting notes to PDF
extras: Desktop only for now; only wikilink images (![[...]]) are supported, not Markdown-syntax or external images; also available in Italian; no network connection, account or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian shows embedded images one after another with no built-in way to place them side by side or flow text around them.

relations.evidence: Compatibility with Better Export PDF has also been tested with version 2.0.3.

summary: Image layout plugin that arranges images in side-by-side rows or with text flowing beside them, consistently in Live Preview, Reading view and PDF.
